items.title: Jim Hall — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: And with Wayne Shorter. That, that worked out... And I think I mentioned this last time, about rehearsing with Wayne Shorter... So we rehearsed there in the, in the hotel... And Wayne was great... So Michel and I played some concerts in Sicily

ctx.x: Was that Montreux? That’s right. And with Wayne Shorter. That, that worked out. But basically, just Michel said, “I’m gonna play this thing,” you know, “I don’t care.” Yeah, I had a lot of affection and admiration for Michel.
What was his music… what was the musical connection between you? Was it, I mean, did it give you something different? Was it a different… did it change your approach over time?
